close_reason: false positive: documented intentional behavior matching zlint byte-floor comparison; not a bug
description: In cabf_tls_br.rs line 255, the check is 'n_bytes >= 256', and the doc comment (lines 203-211) explicitly explains this accepts 2047-bit keys (256 bytes, high bit clear → no leading 0x00). The CA/B Forum TLS BR §6.1.5 requires 'at least 2048 bits', not 2047. The doc notes this matches zlint behavior, but zlint has been criticized for this same floor. A 2047-bit modulus is cryptographically weaker and does not comply with the letter of the spec. This is a correctness/spec-compliance finding — the threshold should be > 256 bytes (strictly) to exclude 2047-bit keys, or the spec citation should be amended with a documented deviation.
title: RsaMinKeySizeLint: modulus length check accepts 2047-bit keys per doc comment — mismatch with spec
